fields.name: QueryResultModelHandler<TArg, TModel> model-mapping callback
fields.contract: A caller supplies this callback to map one executed query's result for a shard into a TModel value. The callback's third parameter is declared as string sprocName — named for a time when every Query was a stored procedure — but DataConnectionManager's only call site (ExecuteQueryWithDelegateAsync, DataConnectionManager.cs line 545) passes query.Sql, the Query's full SQL/command text, not query.Name; the parameter's name is therefore misleading and callers should read it as the executed command text, not a query identifier. The callback also receives the model instance, the short shard identifier, an optional TArg argument, the open DbDataReader, the command's DbParameterCollection (for reading output values), a connection description, and a logger; it returns the resulting TModel.
